item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Log Viewers: Dozzle vs KuLog vs LogViewer
item.description: Kubernetes generates massive amounts of log data — every container writes to stdout/stderr, and every pod can produce dozens of log lines per second. While centralized log aggregation platforms like Loki and Elasticsearch handle long-term storage and analysis, operators often need a lightweight, real-time log viewer for quick debugging.
